newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian semis spreads narrow on RBA ruling.
newsitem.headline: Australian semis spreads narrow on RBA ruling.

text.p: Long-dated Australian semi-government bond yield spreads narrowed one or two basis points after the Reserve Bank said state bonds could be included in commercial bank's prime asset ratio (PAR) requirments.

"This has been rumoured for some time and had been priced in at the short-end, which had been trading fairly flat to government bonds," one trader said. The Reserve Bank also said it was cutting PAR requirements to 3.0 percent.

Under the old PAR requirements banks were required to hold an amount equal to six percent of their liabilities in high quality, readily cashable assets, including notes and coins, and federal government securities.
